articles.title: Trump to throw spotlight on overseas crypto abuses at White House event
articles.summary: The president is hosting a cybercrime event that will highlight U.S. authorities' efforts to crack down on crypto scams run by foreign criminal organizations.

articles.title: How a16z-backed DATA is rethinking its blockchain strategy after $30 million Sui deal
articles.summary: The startup is retiring its own blockchain and moving to Sui with a $30 million investment as it narrows its focus to AI training data.

articles.title: Bybit will look for big broker partnerships to take on Robinhood in the U.S.
articles.summary: When it comes to the U.S., Bybit will look to work with with someone like Interactive Brokers (IB), for example, said CEO Ben Zhou.
